ec_path.label: EC register file
ec_path.description: File that exposes the embedded controller's memory. Usually /sys/kernel/debug/ec/ec0/io (needs the ec_sys module).

ec_offset.label: EC byte offset
ec_offset.description: Which byte of the EC memory holds the camera switch state (decimal). The Lenovo LOQ 15IRX9 uses 31 (0x1F). See the README for how to find yours.

ec_mask.label: EC bit mask
ec_mask.description: Which bit of that byte is set when the camera is ON, as a single-bit value (1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64 or 128). The LOQ 15IRX9 uses 64.

ec_invert.label: Invert state
ec_invert.description: Turn on if your laptop sets the bit when the camera is OFF.

poll_ms.label: Check interval (ms)
poll_ms.description: How often the switch is read. Lower is more responsive; 500 is plenty.

show_osd.label: Show on-screen popup
show_osd.description: Show Noctalia's OSD when the switch changes.
